project.name: ProjexCloud
project.description: The single canonical architecture: a shared horizontal platform — services, agents, contracts, design system, native SDK ecosystem (HDK), and the AIM (Application & Identity Management) foundation — consumed by every vertical we build. Builds once. Multi-tenant. Multi-vertical. Multi-app. Multi-surface (web · mobile · kiosk). Petabyte-scale via pool-based horizontal scaling (no sharding). Identity expressed as a six-layer stack — Master Person · App Identity · Tenant Membership · Persona · Encounter · Relationship — encrypted end-to-end and governed by a three-evaluator access mesh.

epics.title: P10 · E4 — Fail-Closed PDP & Audited Break-Glass
epics.description: Formalize fail-closed-on-evaluator-error for sensitive resource classes, short-TTL cached decisions for low-risk, and an explicit audited break-glass path via sdk-approval (scoped, time-bounded, certificate-of-action). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.6.

epics.title: P10 · E1 — Obligation-Based Authorization (Mask/Filter/TTL on Decisions)
epics.description: Extend the access mesh so policy decisions return obligations (mask_fields, row_filter, audit_level, ttl_seconds), not just ALLOW/DENY. Server-side enforcement of masking/filtering; UI visibility becomes advisory only. Closes the field-leak risk (critique Scenario 7). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.3 + P16 + OC-11.

epics.title: P10 · E2 — Platform Principal Token (Minted, Audience-Bound Internal Identity)
epics.description: Gateway mints a signed, short-TTL, audience-bound token from the resolved IdentityContext; downstream services verify it instead of trusting forwarded headers. Closes the confused-deputy class (Scenario 5). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.4 + P17.

epics.title: P10 · E3 — Consent-Gated Authorization (Purpose-Bound, Fail-Closed)
epics.description: Wire sdk-consent receipts into the sdk-policy decision as a first-class purpose-gated input; missing/revoked receipt fails closed for purpose-bound resources. Includes the healthcare purpose taxonomy (HIPAA TPO + 42 CFR Part 2). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.5 + P18; Required for the healthcare vertical (§11A.10).

epics.title: P10 · E5 — Resource Ownership Registry (GitOps, No-Owner-No-Resource)
epics.description: A platform.resource_registry where every infra resource carries owner/team/repo/terraform_module/cost_center/classification/expiry; GitOps reconciler quarantines orphan/expired resources; OC-12 lint blocks unregistered resources. Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.8 + OC-12.

epics.title: P10 · E6 — Healthcare EMPI / Probabilistic MDM
epics.description: Extend sdk-identity-resolver with probabilistic patient matching for multi-source data: confidence scores, POSSIBLY_SAME candidate links (never forced merges), sdk-approval-governed steward review, reversible merge/unmerge as compensating events, and match-quality calibration. Required for the healthcare vertical (Architecture v3.2 §11A.10).

epics.title: P10 · E7 — Non-Breaking Integration & Regression Hardening
epics.description: Guarantee the P10 changes are additive and break no existing SDK/service: optional obligations/token, additive-only DB migrations, cross-SDK integration & regression suite, and a CI gate requiring full build + isolation/chaos suites green.

epics.title: P10 · E8 — Observability, Audit & Lineage Taxonomy + Telemetry Portal
epics.description: Implement the critique's 8-type observability taxonomy over the existing audit/trace/lineage/meter spine: end-to-end OpenTelemetry tracing, Grafana/Prometheus dashboards, security detection over the SIEM forwarder, plus MDM and consent observability. Addresses Analyze2 §3.11 and Reality Report v2 §4.7.

epics.title: P10 · E9 — Principal Context Enrichment (Device Posture · Network Zone · Purpose)
epics.description: Add device_trust, network_zone, and purpose as first-class context fields on the resolved principal so policy and consent can condition on them. Addresses Reality Report v2 §7.10; purpose feeds the E3 consent-gating decision input.

features.title: Obligations on the policy decision (sdk-policy)
features.description: Add an optional obligations object to EvaluatePolicyResult: mask_fields[], row_filter{}, audit_level, ttl_seconds. Backward compatible — absent obligations = today's behavior.
features.acceptance_criteria:
EvaluatePolicyResult carries an optional obligations object
Existing allow/deny callers compile and behave unchanged
Obligations are emitted in the DecisionRecord audit

features.title: Server-side obligation enforcement helper
features.description: Shared library that applies mask_fields and row_filter to a result set before serialization, called by gateway and data-reading SDKs.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Helper masks declared fields server-side
Helper injects row filters into queries/results
Helper is unit-tested against leak cases

features.title: Candidate links (POSSIBLY_SAME) + confidence scoring
features.description: Represent uncertain matches as POSSIBLY_SAME candidate links with confidence and provenance — never a forced merge.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Candidate links carry confidence + provenance
No automatic destructive merge occurs
Links queryable by confidence band

features.title: Probabilistic matching engine
features.description: Add probabilistic matching over name/DOB/address/phone/external IDs alongside the existing deterministic resolver.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Probabilistic matcher returns candidate matches
Deterministic path unchanged
Configurable match thresholds

features.title: OC-11 lint rule + gateway/SDK wiring
features.description: Lint rule fails any governed-data handler that reads an obligation-bearing decision but serializes raw rows. Wire enforcement into api-gateway read paths.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Lint flags raw serialization of obligation-bearing reads
Gateway applies obligations on governed reads
CI blocks on OC-11 violations

features.title: Gateway principal-token minting
features.description: api-gateway mints a signed, audience-bound, short-TTL JWT from the resolved IdentityContext (sub, app_id, tenant_id, personas, scopes, aud, exp).
features.acceptance_criteria:
Gateway issues a signed principal token post-auth
Token is audience-bound and short-TTL
Token claims derive only from verified IdentityContext

features.title: Downstream token verification middleware
features.description: Shared middleware verifies iss/aud/exp/signature and rejects forwarded user headers as identity sources.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Services verify token signature and claims
Forwarded identity headers are ignored
Invalid/expired tokens are rejected with audit

features.title: Signing-key management & rotation (sdk-vault)
features.description: Principal-token signing keys are issued and rotated through sdk-vault; rotation does not invalidate in-flight short-TTL tokens.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Signing key sourced from sdk-vault
Key rotation scheduled and audited
Rotation overlap honors token TTL

features.title: Consent receipt as policy decision input
features.description: Pass active consent receipts + requested purpose into sdk-policy evaluation as a first-class input.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Policy input includes purpose + consent receipts
Decision considers consent presence/expiry
Consent-derived denials carry reason=consent_absent

features.title: Purpose-gated fail-closed enforcement
features.description: For purpose-bound resources, missing or revoked consent yields DENY (fail closed), with audited reason.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Purpose-bound resource without consent denies
Revocation immediately affects decisions
All consent denials are audited

features.title: Healthcare purpose taxonomy (HIPAA TPO + 42 CFR Part 2)
features.description: Register healthcare purpose codes (treatment/payment/operations/research/marketing) and 42 CFR Part 2 segmented-consent handling for substance-use records.
features.acceptance_criteria:
TPO purpose codes registered
Part 2 segmented consent enforced
Marketing purpose denied for PHI without explicit consent

features.title: Fail-closed PDP on evaluator error
features.description: On evaluator unavailability, sensitive-class access denies; low-risk classes may serve short-TTL cached decisions.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Evaluator error denies sensitive access
Low-risk cached decisions bounded by TTL
Degraded decisions audited

features.title: Audited break-glass via sdk-approval
features.description: Explicit emergency access path: scoped, time-bounded, approval-gated, certificate-of-action, fully audited.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Break-glass requires sdk-approval grant
Access is scoped and time-bounded
Certificate-of-action + audit emitted

features.title: resource_registry schema + read API (sdk-resource-registry)
features.description: Schema with owner/team/repo/terraform_module/cloud_account/cost_center/classification/network_zone/created_by/approved_by/expires_at; thin read API surfaces ownership to admin app.
features.acceptance_criteria:
resource_registry table created (additive migration)
Read API returns ownership for a resource_id
Non-null owner + approved_by required

features.title: GitOps reconciler + orphan quarantine + OC-12 lint
features.description: Terraform/OpenTofu state diff quarantines live-but-unregistered or past-expiry resources and raises ownership alerts; OC-12 lint blocks unregistered provisioning.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Orphan/expired resources are quarantined
Ownership alert raised on violation
OC-12 lint blocks unregistered resources

features.title: Steward review queue (sdk-approval-governed)
features.description: High-risk/ambiguous matches queue to a steward surface; stewards adjudicate via sdk-approval delegation.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Ambiguous matches queue for stewardship
Steward decision recorded with reason
Delegation governed by sdk-approval

features.title: Reversible merge/unmerge as compensating events
features.description: Merges and unmerges are event-sourced and reversible; no destructive deletes.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Merge emits a reversible event
Unmerge emits a compensating event
Full history preserved + auditable

features.title: Match-quality calibration & monitoring
features.description: Track match precision/recall and calibration (e.g., ECE); surface unresolved-identity and merge-reversal metrics.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Calibration metric computed and surfaced
Unresolved/merge-reversal metrics exposed
Threshold drift alerts emitted

features.title: Additive-only contracts & migrations (back-compat)
features.description: Ensure obligations/token/consent-input are optional in @projexlight/contracts and all DB migrations are additive; no breaking schema changes.
features.acceptance_criteria:
New contract fields are optional/additive
Migrations are additive-only (no drops/renames)
Existing consumers compile unchanged

features.title: Cross-SDK integration & regression suite
features.description: Integration tests across identity-resolver → policy(+obligations) → consent → gateway(token) → audit, asserting no regression in existing flows.
features.acceptance_criteria:
End-to-end happy-path test green
Pre-P10 behavior preserved where obligations absent
Cross-tenant isolation tests still pass

features.title: CI gate: full build + isolation/chaos suites green
features.description: CI requires pnpm -w build plus the agent-isolation/chaos suites to pass before P10 changes merge.
features.acceptance_criteria:
CI runs full workspace build
Isolation/chaos suites execute and pass
Merge blocked on red

features.title: End-to-end OTel tracing (frontend -> gateway -> policy -> MDM -> DB)

features.acceptance_criteria:
Single trace spans frontend->gateway->policy->MDM->DB

features.title: Grafana/Prometheus dashboards by observability taxonomy

features.acceptance_criteria:
Prometheus metrics exported
Dashboards grouped by taxonomy

features.title: Security observability + detection rules over SIEM forwarder
features.description: Detection rules over audit/trace streams (auth failures, privilege change, suspicious access) routed to SIEM/XDR via the existing vault SIEM forwarder.
features.acceptance_criteria:
Detection rules defined
Alerts routed to SIEM/XDR

features.title: MDM + consent observability metrics
features.description: Surface MDM observability (match confidence, unresolved identities, merge reversals) and consent observability (consent checked, purpose, receipt id).
features.acceptance_criteria:
MDM match/unresolved/reversal metrics exposed
Consent decision metrics exposed

features.title: Add device_trust + network_zone to principal context
features.description: Add device_trust and network_zone as first-class fields on IdentityContext/principal; capture them at the gateway.

Fields present on principal
Captured at gateway, additive/optional
